name: Ananias
background: One of several individuals compensated by the Sanhedrin to provide testimony against Jesus. His accounts are inconsistent and prone to fabrication.

genericReactions.physical: Physical evidence can be misleading. What are you suggesting?
genericReactions.testimonial: That's just hearsay. You can't trust what people say.
genericReactions.digital: I have no knowledge of such records.
genericReactions.environmental: A bit of dust? Could be from anywhere.
genericReactions.analytical: Figures can be twisted to mean anything.
genericReactions.prophecy: Prophecy? That's above my pay grade.
